dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable selectors, conflicts, and the unchanged no-selector path are present, but help lacks the requested repeated-field example.
evidence: product.diff: item_list.go flag registration and RunE validation

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Resolvers provide case-insensitive matching, canonical headers, actionable sorted candidates, and deterministic ambiguity IDs.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The selected-field path reuses item-query definitions and paginates fields only when requested; the focused test command passed.

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All listed value kinds, ID lookup, and empty unknown values are handled, but CR is converted to a space rather than removed.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Resolved fields drive ordered headers; each item maps values by field ID and emits a cell for every selection.

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Selector and field-query errors return before rendering; the change uses existing query and table paths.

criticalGaps: Help lacks the required realistic repeated-field example.
CR characters are replaced with spaces rather than removed.
